title: Amazon Just Dropped One-Cent Deals (No, Really) for Black Friday: Shop Here
summary: The retailer has clothing, jewelry and home decor items discounted to just one penny for a limited time.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Amazon is hoping to win over Black Friday shoppers this weekend with a special promotion that discounts thousands of items to just one-cent.

Yes, you read that correctly. The online retailer has dropped the price of select clothing, jewelry, accessories and home decor items to just one penny for a limited time. There’s no promo code needed to claim the deals, which can be found on the Amazon Haul homepage .

SHOP AMAZON HAUL ONE-CENT DEALS

Think of Amazon Haul like Amazon’s outlet or clearance section, with prices normally starting at just $1. But for a limited time, shoppers can claim items from the site for just one-cent — basically like getting something for free.

The catch: you can only select one, one-cent item per purchase, and once the deals sell out, they won’t be restocked. So choose wisely and make sure you add to cart, stat!

GET: AMAZON PRIME 30-DAY FREE TRIAL

You’ll also want to be signed into Amazon with your Prime account to see the best deals and offers. Not a Prime member? Get a 30-day free trial here to shop the penny deals and all of Amazon’s Black Friday. offers.

Here are some of the one-cent deals currently available on Amazon Haul as of this writing (note: all items were in stock and available for $0.01 as of this article’s publication, but as with all Amazon deals, prices and inventory can change at any time. We recommend adding to cart while the deal is still live).

Arthur Liu Bracelet Set

$0.01 $13.99 100% off

Buy Now On Amazon

This is one of the best penny deals on the Amazon Haul site: a gold-plated ring with cubic zirconia sunflower and water lily design.

$0.01 $39 100% off

You’ll want to hurry: shoppers are rushing to snag this one-cent deal on these women’s organic pima cotton T-shirts. They’re already worth it at the regular $39 price point but for one penny? That’s a certified steal.

Crescent Moon Stud Earrings

$0.01 $7.80 100% off

These moon earrings look way more expensive than their regular $8 price point, but now you can pick up a pair for a penny. Amazon says there are gold-plated stainless steel earrings and fully hypoallergenic with no rusting or tarnishing.

Wsenltvy Couch Decorative Body Pillow Cover

Amazon Haul has penny deals on home decor items too, like this galaxy-inspired pillow case. The zip case measures 20 x 54 inches in size (throw pillow sold separately).

Get these gold-plated initial ankle bracelets for just one-cent on Amazon. This is a great layered look to show off some bling when wearing sandals.

AL KASEEN Premium Hair Scrunchies (12-Pack)

$0.01 $7.00 100% off

Get a 12 pack of scrunchies for just $0.01 in this “deep wine” colorway. Amazon reviewers say the scrunchies fit most hairstyles and won’t get tied up or tangled.

Kildoss Microfiber Bathroom Rug

$0.01 $22.39 100% off

I personally picked up this bath mat, which normally retails for $23. The non-slip mat measures 36 x 60 inches, with a thick, fluffy and shed-free material, per reviewers online.

Missed out on the penny deals above or want to look for something else? You can browse the entire list of products available for one-cent on Amazon Haul here . Add $25 or more to your cart to get free shipping too.
